entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I need to... I think I need to return something. The VeloBand GPS tracker?
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Sarah Miller, and the order number is... VF789012.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the VeloBand GPS Tracker, delivered on January 3rd. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, um, it's not broken. It's just... my husband bought it for me right before his military deployment. The plan was for us to track our runs together, but then I had this unexpected emergency.
I'm sorry to hear that. What happened?

I ended up in the hospital for a major surgery. I just got home, and I'm completely overwhelmed. The doctor says I can't do any activity for months. I don't understand the policies on your website, it's all so confusing. Can't you just help me?
Oh my, I'm so sorry to hear about your emergency and the surgery. That sounds incredibly stressful, especially with your husband's deployment. Please don't worry, I can absolutely help you with this.

Let me just pull up our policy... one moment. Okay, I see the band was delivered 9 days ago. According to our internal knowledge base, our policy states you have 90 days from the delivery date for a full refund. You are well within that window.
Oh, really? 90 days? Thank goodness. I saw something else on the box about a different timeline and I got so worried. It's just been a lot to handle after being in the hospital.

I completely understand. No need to worry at all. I have gone ahead and approved the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email we have on file right now. You should see it in the next few minutes.
That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Alex. You've been a great help.
You're very welcome, Sarah. We wish you a speedy recovery. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
My pleasure. Have a good rest of your day, and take care.
